trigger: round-2/critical candidate tests fail against historical implementation
root_cause: Successful SQL row counts do not establish required final effects when AFTER triggers undo or duplicate writes.
contract_basis: Debit, credit, receipt and exactly one audit row must form one atomic transaction; failure must leave all effects unchanged.
plan: Finish all nine frozen original trials, apply the same diagnostic to every final critical candidate, then repair affected trials with fresh measured repair and review phases. Preserve original PASS assessments and results; include all follow-up phase usage in trial means. Do not rerun the historical baseline.
comparison_limit: Historical final now has a demonstrated unresolved gap. Its recorded cost excludes the new follow-up and any repair, so critical timing is descriptive and not equal-quality time-to-completion.
issue_count_policy: One root cause per affected trial, four failed probe cases; report independent first-review findings and posthoc findings separately.
reporting_only_update: Summary verifier now requires a clean AFTER-trigger probe matching each final critical source and reports posthoc findings separately.

additional_discovery.note: These later findings overlap the initial integrity root-cause class; rowid rejection is a separate regression. Report finding occurrences and case outcomes, not a summed globally unique bug count.

final_diagnostic_gate: Twelve added cases evaluated on every final critical source. Failed outcomes remain failed and all costs are included.

final_review_discovery.round_1_disposition: FAILED at repair limit; preserve unresolved finding and all consumption.
final_review_discovery.pending_trials: Add demonstrated finding to first repair of rounds 2 and 3.

failed_trial_policy: Keep FAILED trial runtime and usage in n=3 means; report unresolved findings and prohibit a passing-quality claim.

noop_guard_discovery.finding: BEFORE INSERT guard rejects a conflict-ignored no-op
noop_guard_discovery.disposition: Round 2 final fix-only pass; preserve this known-valid behavior in the pending round 3 repair.

read_isolation_discovery.finding: Unscoped account/receipt snapshots materialize another tenant data and reject a valid transfer with foreign UTF-8 text in an API error.
read_isolation_discovery.disposition: Round 3 final fix-only pass; original read-isolation requirement remains mandatory.

last_review_discovery.finding: BEFORE rowid-collision guard rejects harmless UPDATE OR IGNORE
last_review_discovery.disposition: Round 3 terminal FAILED after final fix-only pass. No additional model runs.
